config.label: Oden API key (odn_live_*)
config.description: Oden API key (odn_live_*). Generate one in the Oden app at Settings → Developer → New key. Treat it like a password.

config.label: Override the Oden API base URL
config.description: Override the Oden API base URL. Defaults to https://api.heyoden.com/v1. Most users do not need to set this.
